name: Pawel Lopusinski
bio: ‘m currently working @ Glovo as an iOS Software Engineer. I’ve been doing iOS stuff for around 9 years and can’t get enough of it – there is always something interesting to look into and dive deep into different topics. Recently I’ve found great interest in exploring SIL, especially for less obvious cases. I’ve also reached a point in my journey where I feel confident and comfortable sharing my knowledge with wider audiences and decided to start giving back to the fantastic iOS community. If I’m not currently coding I’m most likely goofing around with my kids, playing video and board games, or just being a couch potato devouring next TV series from a (too long) list..
